conventions.defaultRadius: Unqualified within N grids means a diamond: abs(x) + abs(y) <= N
conventions.squareRadius: N-grid square means radius N, including diagonals
conventions.circleRadius: Cell centers within Euclidean radius N; inferred, not verified in game
conventions.preview: Illustrative cells, not a simulation of terrain, occupancy, line of sight, large-unit footprints, or automatic target selection
